notice: Study tooling only — synthetic data does not establish OCR accuracy, clinical validation or release approval.

outcomes.name: page shows the study-tooling notice and the synthetic storage status
owner creates a study and adds one member per role
owner cannot see custodian, annotation or adjudication controls and has no accept action
custodian registers the synthetic sample dataset, records the attestation and generates the manifest
annotator sees only their assigned dataset, its cases, and an upload box — no queue, agreement, audit or manifest
annotator uploads their own annotations; the page confirms a new immutable version
the second annotator cannot see the first annotator’s work
adjudicator reviews the blind queue and adjudicates every item without seeing annotator identities
adjudicator has no annotation import, manifest or evaluation controls
custodian builds the truth and locks; the lock digest is shown with the instruction to record it OUTSIDE the system
verification of a locked dataset demands the external digest; a wrong digest fails; the right one passes
statistician runs a locked evaluation and exports the report; the page states no acceptance is made
clinical lead can set severity labels but has no evaluation, lock or accept controls
auditor reads the audit log (ids/hashes only) and has no write controls
policy panel: banner, 13 fields all unconfigured, hash-chain integrity, no pre-filled value, no activate/approve/accept/release control
statistician prepares a draft (value + source reference), saves it and submits it for review
self-review is refused with a clear message and the policy stays a draft
a different member records the review (references only); the panel still says draft / ineligible and shows no activation control
aud: policy panel is visible but read-only (no value inputs, no save, no submit, no review buttons)
cust: policy panel is visible but read-only (no value inputs, no save, no submit, no review buttons)
annotator sees no policy panel at all
an unauthorised viewer account is refused by the API and sees no study data
